content:
Chloe Martin: heads up: SCM Console+Optimize integration tests are failing in staging again. buildkite step `scm-integration-staging` red.

Chloe Martin: error from Console test runner:
```
POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/internal/cost-model/estimate
-> 400
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
    "message": "missing required field: region"
  }
}
```
We *do* set region in prod payloads; looks like our staging fixture is missing it? :eyes:

Buildkite Bot: Build #118742 failed in step: scm-integration-staging
Buildkite Bot: Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/console-backend/builds/118742

Ethan Park: yep, this is the same validator path we tightened this week. SCM service now requires `region` *or* `deployment_region` (depending on client version) and staging tests are still on old fixture.

Jordan Lee: wait, the error says missing `region` specifically. Are we negotiating v1 or v1.1 in staging? If it’s hitting v1 schema it should accept `region` only; v1.1 accepts `region` and `cloud_region` alias (but we never shipped that?)

Amara Diallo: looking at gateway logs for that request id (from buildkite): request has header `x-redwood-cost-model-version: 2025-02-01` (lol) which is not a real semantic version. That might be forcing version parsing into a weird branch.

Chloe Martin: ugh. That header value is coming from the test harness env var `SCM_VERSION` which is set to a date string in staging (legacy from pricing sandbox). We expected service to ignore unknown version and default.

Jordan Lee: it currently does NOT ignore. If `x-redwood-scm-version` is present and not parseable/unsupported we return 400 `UNSUPPORTED_VERSION`. But the 400 we see is `INVALID_ARGUMENT` for missing region, so we *are* parsing something.

Ethan Park: I can reproduce locally against staging: if the version header is unrecognized, service falls back to v1 but still uses the *new* required-field validator list (bug). That’s on us.

Benji Okafor: +1 saw a related failure yesterday. quick fix options:
1) patch test harness to stop sending that header in staging
2) patch scm-service to make v1 validator actually v1
I’d prefer (1) for immediate green + (2) follow-up

Dylan Brooks: for Console side I can patch the staging integration tests right now. We can set `SCM_VERSION=v1` or unset header entirely. Question: do we also need to add `region` into the fixture payload?

Nadia Rahman: please add `region` regardless. runtime telemetry always tags region, but these fixtures were hand-written and missing it. also: the `deployment_type` field is `"dedicated"` in one scenario but no `gpu_sku` -> SCM will drop confidence to low; not failing but FYI.

Logan Wright: +1, adding region will also help avoid a weird join in telemetry-backed explain tests. In staging the metrics are sparse and the fallback path uses region as a partition key.

Chloe Martin: ok action plan:
- Dylan: patch Console staging test harness to stop sending date string header + add region to fixtures
- Ethan/Jordan: patch scm-service validator to not apply v1.1 requirements when version resolves to v1
- Benji: re-run staging canary after merges
Sound good?

Rafael Mendes: if we re-run canary, please ping me. I can watch mismatch dashboard too; last time the rerun hid a real regression.

Jordan Lee: I’ll take scm-service bug. Root cause: `ResolvedVersion` returns v1 but `RequiredFields` is keyed off `RequestedVersion` (raw header string) and we treat “present” as v1.1+.

Jordan Lee: quick patch: only enable strict validator when `ResolvedVersion >= v1.1` AND `TelemetryMode == metered`. For estimate endpoint default should be tolerant w/ assumptions.

Ethan Park: careful: PMs asked for strict validation for estimate too (determinism + no silent assumptions). But for v1 we explicitly said missing region => assumption allowed with confidence drop. So gating by resolved version is correct.

Dylan Brooks: I’ll push a quick PR to console-backend test harness. Proposed change:
- if `SCM_VERSION` doesn’t match `/^v\d+(\.\d+)?$/` then don’t set header
- add `region: "us-east-1"` to staging fixtures

Amara Diallo: also, gateway strips unknown headers in some routes but not internal ones. Prefer explicitly setting `x-redwood-scm-version: v1` if you want it deterministic.

Chloe Martin: do that. Setting `v1` is fine. We’re not testing negotiation in Console repo anyway.

Buildkite Bot: Build #118751 started by Dylan Brooks
Buildkite Bot: Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/console-backend/builds/118751

Dylan Brooks: PR up (internal): `console-backend#18592` (staging tests set `x-redwood-scm-version: v1` + add region). Should be quick to merge.

Jordan Lee: scm-service patch in progress. Added regression test:
```
when resolved=v1 and header=garbage -> validator uses v1 required set
```
Will open PR in ~10.

Logan Wright: while you’re in there, can we make error message include which field path is missing and which version was resolved? Super helpful for oncall.

Jordan Lee: yep. adding `details.resolved_version` and `details.missing_fields` (string list) to INVALID_ARGUMENT.

Ethan Park: +1 but make sure it doesn’t break clients expecting current error schema. Put it in `error.details` and keep strings only.

Benji Okafor: once Dylan PR merges, I can manually re-run the staging integration suite even before scm-service fix, but it might still fail if scm-service is applying the wrong required list. let’s wait for both.

Buildkite Bot: Build #118751 passed

Dylan Brooks: console changes are green. merged.

Jordan Lee: scm-service PR is up: `redwood#18696` (validator gating by resolved version + better error details). Requesting review from Ethan + Naomi (since it touches error payload).

Ethan Park: looking now.

Chloe Martin: thank you. once merged, Benji can rerun staging integration tests?

Benji Okafor: yep. I’ll kick rerun as soon as `redwood#18696` hits staging.

Rafael Mendes: please drop the request id(s) in thread once rerun starts; I’ll tail Grafana for p95 + error rate.

Ethan Park: approved. one nit: make sure `resolved_version` string is `"v1"` not `"1"`.

Jordan Lee: fixed + pushed.

Buildkite Bot: Merge queued for redwood#18696 by Jordan Lee

Amara Diallo: FYI staging deploy window in ~25 mins. If merge misses it we’ll have to wait 2h.

Benji Okafor: got it. I’ll watch deploybot.

Buildkite Bot: Deploy started: cost-model-service (staging) build 6641
Buildkite Bot: Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/platform-deploys/builds/6641

Benji Okafor: deploy in progress. once healthy, rerunning Console integration suite.

Buildkite Bot: Deploy finished: cost-model-service (staging) build 6641

Benji Okafor: rerun started: `console-backend` build #118763 `scm-integration-staging`

Rafael Mendes: watching dashboards now. error rate normal so far; no spikes.

Buildkite Bot: Build #118763 passed in step: scm-integration-staging

Chloe Martin: :tada: staging integration tests green again. thanks all.

Ethan Park: follow-up: we should clean up that `SCM_VERSION` env var in staging so it can’t be set to random date strings again.

Dylan Brooks: I’ll file a small ticket on our side to remove it + rely on client default (or set explicit v1).

Jordan Lee: I’ll add a unit test for “garbage version header returns UNSUPPORTED_VERSION” *only* when it’s explicitly required, and update ADR language. Current behavior was ambiguous.

Chloe Martin: cool. closing the loop here.
